name: aero-closing-horizon
prompt: A tall portrait frame of a glossy mid-2000s desktop-wallpaper paradise at the hour just before dusk. Low across the bottom of the picture, a single smooth grassy rise swells from edge to edge, its lawn so even it looks polished, sunlit lime on the crest and sliding into deep emerald where it turns away from the light, tiny beads of dew catching glints. Above it the sky takes up almost everything: a clear, lacquered gradient running from bright saturated aqua high overhead, through pale cyan, down to a soft violet-tinged dusk blue that sits just above the grass line, with one faint white ribbon of light curving low near the horizon and nothing else up there, no clouds, no birds, no sun disc, an empty glassy expanse filling the upper two-thirds. Five or six last soap-clear bubbles rise from the hilltop toward the upper left, each a thin transparent sphere with a crisp white crescent highlight on its top rim and a fainter reflected arc on the lower edge, the highest ones already small and drifting out of frame. Exactly on the crest, dead centre and small in the frame, a single person stands upright and full length, facing straight at the camera, arms relaxed at the sides, in a dark plain jacket and trousers, dark knitted gloves, and a close-fitting dark knitted balaclava that covers the entire head with no openings at all for eyes, nose or mouth, a thick white ring stitched around the whole face and one small red triangle with softly rounded corners, point downward, set high inside the ring on the right side of the picture; no skin visible anywhere. Long lens from slightly below the crest, the figure crisp, a gentle rim of warm low light outlining the shoulders, the sky silky and noise-free like rendered CGI, colours rich but calm. The mood is hushed and courteous, the optimistic future pausing, a full stop after a polite sentence. No text, no lettering, no logos anywhere in the image. Thanks.
